newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's rates HK Mortgage Finance FRNS Aaa.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's rates HK Mortgage Finance FRNS Aaa.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday has assigned a Aaa rating to Hong Kong Mortgage Financing Ltd's HK$778 million guaranteed floating rate notes (FRNs).
Moody's said the Aaa rating assigned to the FRNs was based on the irrevocable and unconditional guarantee of principle and interest provided by MBIA Assurance SA (rated Aaa).

Moody's said the Aaa rating also reflected the ability of MBIA to fulfill its obligations under the note guaranty insurance policy in U.S. dollar equivalent of the Hong Kong dollar amount if MBIA is not possible to obtain sufficient HK
Hong Kong Mortgage Financing Ltd is a special purpose company incorporate in Jersey.
Socgen Asia Securitisation Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Societe Generale Australia Ltd, is the funding and investment adviser for the issuer.
The issuer would use the proceeds of the notes to fund the investor note issued by Societe Generale Asia Ltd in its capacity as trust of the Mortgage Financing Trust.
